1_primitives.purpose: Edge, Outcome, Historization (U/F traces, decay), Tension (S_eff = Δ · R_eff)

2_landscape.purpose: L_t = (X_t, E_t, v_t, S_t, H_t) — reachable states, edges, transition field, tension, historization

3_controller.purpose: E0Controller — greedy navigation with amplitude override, SU(2) phases, 4 escalation types (DEAD_END, FILTERED, EXHAUSTED, OVERLOADED), peer_fn for external consultation

4_phase_amplitude.purpose: Amplitude override (high-Δ beats greedy when Δ·confidence > threshold), Born sampling, SU(2) spinor phases, stochastic exploration

5_reflexion.purpose: Stufe 1 (reactive: stuck → propose edges from experience), Stufe 2 (proactive: frontier → propose before stuck), Stufe 3 (self-graph: E₀ observes its own structure)

6_multiverse.purpose: N≥2 coupled E₀ systems. NoveltyGate prevents Δ-Kollaps. CouplingRouter with RECOVERY/EXPLORATION dual pressure. Asymmetric weights (C67). CouplingSelfGraph (C68): Stufe-3 reflexion for coupling pipeline with diagnose_coupling(). Coupling Theorem (C54).

7_llm_integration.purpose: E₀=Skeleton (structure/judgment), LLM=Muscle (generation/exploration). Bootstrapper: spec→Landscape. ModeController: LEARN/EXECUTE/COMBINATION.

8_observation.purpose: E₀ observes its own landscape as a navigable domain. O-Landscape (scoped projection with focus/move/defocus), ObservationController (session-aware navigation), RenderingAdapter (→ GraphView wire format). Wired to server (3 REST endpoints) and client (Observe toggle + node-click navigation).

9_dream_mode.purpose: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. EdgeFingerprint f(e)=(q,m,I), functional equivalence detection (quantile-based), DreamObserver (N domains, dream_cycle, feedback historization), bridge hypothesis generation (→ cross_propose_edges), make_dream_peer_fn (E0Controller integration). Dream Landscape is self-historizing valid E₀ Landscape. C109-C112.

10_structural_entropy.purpose: Forgetting as structural necessity. Type 1: inscription threshold (novelty > ε, controlled by T_s). Type 2: anchor analysis (anchor_score = |q̄|·m_max·log(1+deg)), decay candidates, apply_decay (3-phase: trace→remove→clean). Controller: inscription_threshold opt-in. Dream: decay_enabled opt-in. Only new parameter: θ_base (anchor threshold). C114-C120.

11_sleep_wake.purpose: Automatic sleep-wake rhythm. dream_pressure = T_s/(T_s+μ) triggers dreaming when T_s > μ. SleepWakeCycle orchestrates Controller + DreamObserver: wake builds experience, sleep consolidates + decays, cycle repeats. Parameter-free trigger (uses existing μ). C121.

12_curriculum.purpose: Hierarchical learning for canonical landscapes. CurriculumStrategy generates cumulative turns from derivation levels. EquilibriumDetector monitors T_s stability (replaces goal-reaching as stop). build_scoped_landscape creates sub-landscapes per turn. transfer_historization carries traces across turns. CurriculumRunner orchestrates end-to-end. C123.

key_formulas.navigation: argmin S_eff/(M_H·I) (greedy with overlap+inertia), with amplitude override when Δ·conf > threshold
key_formulas.graduated_overlap: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))), greedy divides S_eff by M_H
key_formulas.inertia_factor: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|), greedy divides S_eff by I

C126b Confidence-Gated Bootstrap — gated (min_confidence=6) vs ungated (min_confidence=2) comparison. Gated: fewer pairs (16 vs 25) but rankings STABLE (mouth 6→8%ile vs 6→16%ile). Gated 50% accuracy vs ungated 40%. Gate preserves discrimination but limits growth.

C126c Weighted Dictionary Bootstrap — 3-tier graduation (canonical/tentative/confirmed). Stochastic execute_fn for tentative entries. 4/4 confirmed pairs 100% correct. Decay removes wrong entries naturally. Distance collapse by R2 limits discrimination — dream works on topology alone. quality↔eigenschaft paradox: high initial weight prevents rediscovery.

C127 Level-2 Pair-Based Validation — p(SUCCESS)=w(source)×w(target). Distance collapse PREVENTED: 64→52→99→154→116→135→77→68 (vs L1: 53→1). S/F ratio stable ~30%. R7=5/5 correct, 20/32 unknown pairs top-10%ile. Oscillation between rounds. 1 confirmed (quality), 7/11 tentative correct.

C127b Cumulative Vote Bootstrap — FALSIFICATION. weight=f(cumulative_votes). Wrong pairs accumulate consistently: relation↔essen_n 36v promoted, food↔beziehung 28v promoted. Only 2/4 confirmed correct (50%). Distance diversity preserved (64→38→55→83→111...). Pure accumulation amplifies systematic structural false matches.

C128 Level-3 Neighborhood Consistency — bidirectional context scoring: for each candidate en↔de, translate neighbors and check structural overlap. w=base_w×context_score. Promotion gated by context≥50%. 4/4 confirmed=100% (food, quality, action, relation). Wrong pairs (go↔kalt ctx=0%, thing↔kalt ctx=0%) never promoted. relation↔essen_n NEVER APPEARED as discovery (suppressed by context-weighted execute_fn).

C129 Competitive Exclusion — structural gate: promotion requires being best candidate for both EN and DE word. 0 promotions blocked (defense-in-depth, false pairs never reach threshold). Committed 95a01a8.

C130 Confidence-Weighted Edge-Role Matching — votes weighted by equivalence.confidence instead of +1. Edge-role context: compare quality/load/inertia fingerprints of matched edge pairs. 11→13 firm, 2/2=100% confirmed. Edge-Role Score shows clear separation (correct 72-100%, wrong mostly 0%). Committed 9a3a447.

C131 Seed Expansion Experiment — 4 configs on v1.1 canons: B(11)→13 firm, C(18)→21 firm, C+R2(20)→23 firm, C+R5(23)→26 firm. Bridge edges (C131 Phase 1) created false positives (make↔nehmen ctx=100%) — reverted. Seed expansion is dominant lever. relation↔beziehung: B=tentative ctx=?, C=tentative ctx=0%, R2=tentative ctx=71%, R5=confirmed ctx=100%. Diagnosis: canon topology too shallow (avg degree 2.9, 64 edges on 44 nodes) — node fingerprints not locally unique. 52% seed needed for 59% coverage = not learning, just seeding. Next: LLM-enriched canons with typed relations (sees_with, opposite_of, used_for etc.) to create unique structural fingerprints per node.

key_modules_quick_ref.multiverse.py: Universe(name, landscape, execute_fn, start, goal). MultiverseController(a, b). NoveltyGate. LandscapeSnapshot.

CouplingRouter(universes, coupling_weights={...}). select_partner(requester, reason). historize(src,tgt,outcome,weight_mod_active,distance_mod_active). set_weight(). self_graph=CouplingSelfGraph().
